title: Your 12-week plan
label: A twelve-week training plan on a time axis with three tracks: Training, Nutrition and Check-ins. A Today marker walks the weeks; completed sessions fill in, training blocks fill as it passes, later ones stay outlined. When it reaches the first 10K run in week 9 its flag opens into a card.
heading:
Twelve weeks
to your first 10K.
sub: Each week builds on the last. Your coach adjusts the plan after every check-in.

milestones.title: First 10K run
milestones.note: Your longest run yet, paced from your last four weeks of training.
